gloss: to cry out; to wail; to scream and cry

definitions.gloss: to cry out; to wail; to scream and cry
definitions.explanation: To cry loudly while screaming or shouting, expressing extreme grief, pain, or distress. A compound verb combining 泣く (to cry) and 叫ぶ (to shout).

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもが{泣|な}き{叫|さけ}んでいる。
{痛|いた}みに{耐|た}えきれず{泣|な}き{叫|さけ}んだ。
examples.english: Unable to bear the pain, I cried out.

examples.japanese: {母親|ははおや}を{亡|な}くした{少女|しょうじょ}は{泣|な}き{叫|さけ}びながら{地面|じめん}に{崩|くず}れ{落|お}ちた。
examples.english: The girl who had lost her mother collapsed to the ground, wailing.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound verb that expresses more intense emotion than {泣|な}く alone. Often used in dramatic or literary descriptions of grief, pain, or desperation.

CONJUGATION:
Conjugates as a godan verb ending in ぶ: {泣|な}き{叫|さけ}ばない, {泣|な}き{叫|さけ}びます, {泣|な}き{叫|さけ}んで, etc.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {泣|な}く: to cry — general, less intense
- {号泣|ごうきゅう}する: to bawl, cry loudly — emphasizes volume of crying
- {喚|わめ}く: to scream, yell — emphasizes the shouting aspect
